title: Hearing Aids Fell From $4,700 To $300 Over The Counter
hook: Hearing aids that cost $4,700 can now start near $300.
closing: Cheaper hearing aids remove one barrier between hearing loss and everyday connection.
question: Who could benefit from cheaper hearing aids?

segments.say: Prescription hearing aids cost $4,700 per pair. Over-the-counter competition broke that old price barrier.
Only 20 percent of people with hearing loss use hearing aids. Price and access kept most away.
Shoppers can now choose from more than 80 hearing aid models without a prescription.
